name: ORC-mkX Core SecondWind
description:
Item Type: Medium Armor
Damage Reduction: 30%
Temp. Rating: -61 / 91 °C
Radiation Protection: 26400 REM
Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s
Carrying Capacity: 7.5K µSCU
Backpacks: Medium, Light

This version of CDS' ORC-mkX combat armor has been modified from its original form. The mark X is part of CDS’ award-winning Omni-Role Combat armor series. This EVA-rated suit features new EdgeCore composite weave technology, maximizing protection against projectiles, explosives and the elements while minimizing operator agility.

To honor those who came to Orison's aid in its time of need, the SecondWind edition compliments the armor with a rich blue base adorned with a sleek, flowing air design.
